note.heading: Technology Changes the World. Technology Transforms Lives.
paragraphs: Life is more than just living. Work is more than just working. Technology is more than just technology.
It is about exploring, creating, connecting, and making an impact.

I believe technology is a catalyst for innovation and transformation. Throughout my career, I have been passionate about building innovative products, developing technology teams, and turning technology into meaningful business impact.
Today, my focus is on AI, digital transformation, product innovation, and building scalable technology organizations.

Beyond technology and work, I enjoy traveling, exploring new places, experiencing different cultures, and embracing new ideas and experiences. I believe curiosity, exploration, and continuous learning make both life and work more meaningful.
Stay curious. Keep exploring. Keep building.

highlights: Leading engineering for CTV and Smart TV platforms, including AI and digital transformation.
Built Salesforce-style CRM and a marketing affiliate management system.
